fullPassage: Science is concerned with accumulating and understanding observations of the physical world. That understanding alone solves no problems. Individual people have to act on that understanding for it to help solve problems. For instance, science has found that regular exercise can lower your risk of heart disease. Knowing this fact is interesting, but it will do nothing for your personal health unless you act on it and actually exercise. And that's the hard part. Reading an article about exercise is easy. Getting into an actual routine of regular exercise is harder. In this sense, science really solves no problems at all. Problems are only solved when people take the knowledge provided by science and use it. In fact, many of humanity's biggest problems are caused by lack of action, and not lack of knowledge.

✅ ② observations: understanding observations — 타동사 + 명사 목적어. 문법 정상.

❌ ③ for it helping → for it to help: 'for + 목적격 + to부정사' 구문. helping(동명사)은 이 구조에서 불가. ←정답

✅ ④ provided: knowledge provided by science — 과거분사의 후치수식. '과학에 의해 제공된 지식'. 문법 정상.
det.tip: for + 목적격 + to부정사: for it to help (O) / for it helping (X)

det.korean: ② if → unless: '~하지 않는 한'의 의미로 unless가 맞음. if는 의미 반전
det.analysis:
✅ ① concerned: is concerned with — be concerned with(~에 관심을 두다). 과거분사 형용사. 문법 정상.

❌ ② if → unless: 원문 unless you act on it and actually exercise. '행동하지 않는 한 아무 소용없다'는 맥락. if로 바꾸면 '행동하면 아무 소용없다'로 의미가 반전. ←정답

✅ ③ harder: Getting into a routine is harder — 비교급. 1음절 형용사 hard + -er. 문법 정상.

✅ ④ caused: problems are caused by — be + 과거분사 수동태. 문법 정상.
det.tip: unless = if ~ not: unless you act (O, 행동하지 않으면) / if you act (X, 행동하면 → 의미 반전)

✅ ② actually: actually exercise — 동사 exercise를 수식하는 부사. 문법 정상.

✅ ③ solved: Problems are only solved when — be + 과거분사 수동태. 문법 정상.

✅ ④ use: take the knowledge and use it — take와 use가 and로 병렬 연결된 동사원형. 문법 정상.

✅ ④ biggest: humanity's biggest problems — '가장 큰'. 인류의 가장 큰 문제들이라는 맥락에 적절.

questions.passage: Science is concerned with accumulating and understanding observations of the physical world. That understanding alone solves no problems. Individual people have to act on that understanding for it to help solve problems. For instance, science has found that regular exercise can lower your risk of heart disease. Knowing this fact is interesting, but it will do nothing for your personal health unless you act on it and actually exercise. And that's <u>the hard part</u>. Reading an article about exercise is easy. Getting into an actual routine of regular exercise is harder. In this sense, science really solves no problems at all. Problems are only solved when people take the knowledge provided by science and use it. In fact, many of humanity's biggest problems are caused by lack of action, and not lack of knowledge.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'the hard part'가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '어려운 부분' = 알고 있는 것을 꾸준한 실천으로 전환하는 것
det.analysis:
❌ ① acquiring scientific knowledge about health risks
(건강 위험에 관한 과학 지식을 습득하는 것)
→ 본문: Knowing this fact is interesting — 지식 습득은 '흥미로운' 것이지 '어려운' 것이 아님.

❌ ② finding reliable articles about physical exercise
(운동에 관한 신뢰할 수 있는 기사를 찾는 것)
→ 본문: Reading an article about exercise is easy — 기사 읽기는 '쉬운' 것.

❌ ③ understanding how diseases affect the human body
(질병이 인체에 미치는 영향을 이해하는 것)
→ 본문: 질병 이해가 아니라 행동 실천이 어려운 부분.

✅ ④ translating what you know into consistent practice
(알고 있는 것을 꾸준한 실천으로 전환하는 것)
→ 근거: unless you act on it and actually exercise. And that's the hard part. 앞 문장에서 '행동하고 실제로 운동해야' 한다고 했고, 그것이 어려운 부분. ←정답
det.tip: the hard part = 지식 → 행동 전환의 어려움. act on it이 핵심 단서.
